name: SKSDiagnoses
title: SKS Diagnoses - Danish ICD-10 diagnosis register (D-hierarchy)
description: The Danish SKS diagnosis register (the 'D-hierarchy'): the Danish edition of ICD-10, where each diagnosis code is the ICD-10 code prefixed with a literal 'D' (e.g. SKS 'DA022' == ICD-10 'A02.2'). Published under urn:oid:1.2.208.176.2.4.12 and generated from SKScomplete.txt by scripts/sks_icd10_diff.py. Provided so legacy SKS diagnosis codings continue to resolve; the modern model is plain ICD-10 together with the icd10-danish-extensions CodeSystem and the icd10-da designation supplement.
